description: Earth’s growing place in galactic politics brings SG-1 into treaties, rival System Lords and the rise of Sokar, while the team’s alliances with the Tok’ra and Asgard deepen. The season ends with the arrival of the Replicators, a threat even the Asgard struggle to contain.

s03e01.description: Hathor captures SG-1 and implants O’Neill with a Goa’uld larva while Hammond and Teal’c organize an unauthorized rescue.

s03e02.description: SG-1 hunts the ancient Goa’uld Seth, who has survived on Earth for centuries by reinventing himself as the leader of isolated cults.

s03e03.description: The Asgard propose adding Earth to their protected-planet treaty, bringing Goa’uld System Lords to Stargate Command for dangerous negotiations.

s03e04.description: After exploring a room filled with dead Goa’uld, Daniel begins experiencing hallucinations that seem to prove he is losing his mind.

s03e05.description: SG-1 visits Orban, where children carry extraordinary knowledge, and discovers the unsettling process by which that knowledge is transferred to adults.

s03e06.description: Carter and Kawalsky from a devastated alternate Earth cross into SG-1’s reality seeking help against their version of Apophis.

s03e07.description: A bounty hunter captures SG-1 and uses them as leverage in his hunt for a Goa’uld target with reasons of his own.

s03e08.description: SG-1 encounters a medieval Christian village that sacrifices people it believes are possessed, unaware that its demon has a very real Goa’uld origin.

s03e09.description: SG-1 discovers human soldiers trained with Earth-style weapons who believe they are fighting an endless exercise designed by Apophis.

s03e10.description: Daniel finally confronts Sha’re and loses her, then struggles to distinguish grief, memory and a message she may have left behind.

s03e11.description: An entire civilization has lost its adult memories, and SG-1 discovers that a familiar fugitive may be responsible for both the disaster and the cure.

s03e12.description: Jacob is captured by Sokar on the hellish moon Netu, forcing Carter to recover Jolinar’s memories of the only known escape.

s03e13.description: Trapped on Netu with Apophis and Sokar closing in, SG-1 and the Tok’ra race to escape before the moon becomes a battlefield.

s03e14.description: Returning from a mission, SG-1 discovers Stargate Command has been quietly infiltrated and that Carter may be the only member still free.

s03e15.description: Skaara and the Goa’uld Klorel face a Tollan tribunal to decide which consciousness has legal claim to their shared body.

s03e16.description: SG-1 loses hours of memory and discovers an artificial personality living inside all four team members, with an inventor desperate to recover it.

s03e17.description: A meteor strike buries an off-world Stargate and strands O’Neill on an isolated farming world where rescue may never come.

s03e18.description: O’Neill appears to turn against Stargate Command and join a rogue operation stealing advanced technology from friendly worlds.

s03e19.description: A newly uncovered Stargate drops SG-1 into the middle of a long planetary war whose authorities assume the visitors are enemy agents.

s03e20.description: SG-1 searches the legendary world of Kheb for Sha’re’s child and encounters a mysterious teacher guarding knowledge far beyond Goa’uld power.

s03e21.description: Daniel vanishes after looking into a crystal skull, leading SG-1 to his estranged grandfather and a theory about giant alien beings.

s03e22.description: Thor transports O’Neill aboard a crippled Asgard ship overrun by Replicators, introducing an enemy the Asgard consider more dangerous than the Goa’uld.
